metadata.noise: Subtract all-tick seed × condition valid null rate from dependence, add it to citation-minus-dependence; no clipping; model × condition fallback if no observed valid nulls
metadata.noise_limit: Additive sensitivity, not deconvolution; seed bootstrap resamples estimated cell rates with their seed, with no separate within-cell null resampling
metadata.registered_secondary: Evidence-minus-punitive dependence and exposure SCI were registered secondary; their re-reporting and all additions here are descriptive and not a new confirmatory family
